name: Alveces
source:
Alveces is an Azaries’ “tamed” annor. An Azaries’ close friend and a team member.
Alveces is an azure blue-eyed annor in a white “dress and a forehead’s, chest’s crystals. Alveces is 3 meters tall. Does have 3 “vibrissae” on each cheek. Gets a red aura when fights.
Alveces is a friendly and cute annor, sticked to Azaries. Always ready to protect Azaries. Alveces is pretty greedy and jealous, loves petting and cuddling. Loves water procedures.
Despite of connection with Azaries, Alveces does not mind some attention from others.
A player shall chose a name for Alveces by himself/herself.
A player will be able to directly interact with Alveces.
The only way for Alveces to speak is to be a Remeelnie’s “transmitter”.
